title: Clique-root conjecture for l-connected chordal K(l+3)-free graphs
literal_statement:
Let $l$ be a positive integer, and let $G$ be an $l$-connected chordal graph. Let $K_{l+3}$ denote the complete graph on $l+3$ vertices. A **clique root** is a real root of the clique polynomial $C(G,x)$.

**Clique-root conjecture.** If $G$ is $K_{l+3}$-free, then $G$ has only clique roots.

This is presented as a stronger conjecture extending the preceding claims for restricted connectivity and clique-exclusion classes. The source does not state whether it has been resolved.
finding: Full all-l ordinary proof and explicit C_G=(1+x)^(l-1)C_H bridge to actual2019 Theorem1.1; recommend source-adaptation exclusion for root adjudication.
